strategies.name: fvg_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Identify the fair value gap that caused a break of structure in the direction of the trend, preferably one close to an order block. Wait for price to retrace back into that FVG, then enter in the trend direction from the gap area.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself—below the FVG for buys and above it for sells—and hold for continuation in the expected direction.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to tap back into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to return to the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: prefer the FVG very close to the order block rather than any arbitrary gap
variants.transcript_quote: map out the FVG that cost the break of structure the FVG that is very close to the order block

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one FVG trend-continuation retest skeleton; bullish/sell-side examples and the preference for an FVG near an order block are compatible variants, not distinct strategies.
